content: Sauron is one of the most famous villains of all time, but The Lord of the Rings doesn’t really explore why the Dark Lord is so obsessed with conquering all of Middle-earth. The prequel series The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power has been working to make Sauron (Charlie Vickers) more complex — which isn’t hard since he gets to have conversations with other characters rather than solely appear as an ominous eye. He’s a master of deception who has appeared in multiple guises to further his schemes, but in one of the latest episodes released Wednesday, Sauron gets honest and reveals his true motivations.
